record.paper_title: Three open problems in function theoretic operator theory
record.original_question: Let A be an n by n normal matrix. Let W(A) be its numerical range, sigma(A) its spectrum, and for each k let A_k be the (n - 1) by (n - 1) matrix obtained from A by deleting the kth row and kth column. Let H denote Hausdorff distance between compact subsets of the complex plane. Is max_{1 <= k <= n} H(W(A), sigma(A_k)) <= min_{c in C} ||A - cI||?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
Let $A$ be an $n \times n$ normal complex matrix. Denote by $W(A) = \{\langle Ax, x\rangle : x \in \mathbb{C}^n,\ \|x\|=1\}$ its numerical range and by $\sigma(A)$ its spectrum (the set of eigenvalues). For each $k \in \{1, \dots, n\}$, let $A_k$ denote the $(n-1) \times (n-1)$ principal submatrix of $A$ obtained by deleting the $k$th row and the $k$th column. For compact subsets $K, L \subset \mathbb{C}$, let
$$H(K,L) = \max\Bigl(\sup_{z \in K} \operatorname{dist}(z, L),\ \sup_{w \in L} \operatorname{dist}(w, K)\Bigr)$$
denote the Hausdorff distance. Let $\|\cdot\|$ denote the operator norm. Determine whether the inequality
$$\max_{1 \le k \le n} H\bigl(W(A),\ \sigma(A_k)\bigr) \ \le\ \min_{c \in \mathbb{C}} \|A - cI\|$$
holds for every $n \times n$ normal matrix $A$.
artifact.status_search_result: The problem is posed as a conjecture attributed to Borcea concerning normal matrices, their numerical ranges, and the spectra of principal submatrices. Web searches did not turn up any published resolution. It is featured as one of three open problems in a recent survey on function-theoretic operator theory, suggesting it remains open.
